chapter: Los Angeles scene, Tatum and Billy Berg's
title: Billy Berg's clubs in Los Angeles
summary: He played nearly every Billy Berg club, mostly with Slam Stewart's group.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, Billy Bergs used to have a nightclub here.
Which one of Billy Berg's clubs did you play? Or did you play more than one?
Oh, I played in practically every one he ever had
There was...the last one was the one on Vine Street, right? But before that, he had one on Beverly Boulevard and one on...what...La Cienega...or near La Cienega on...uh, on what street? Uh...
And then there was one on Hollywood Boulevard. Right?
I don't know...I don't know too much about Hollywood. All I know is that I would go to 'em.
(Laughs). I think there were four he had all together, weren't there?
Yeah, I hadn't...I haven't seen him in years. I think he's dead now.
Yeah, I think he is, too. So you worked all those Billy Berg's clubs. Who'd you work there with? Who played for you?
Mostly Slam Stewart an' them played.
